topic: Year-end supermarket and a date report
title_jp: {年末|ねんまつ}のスーパーと{報告|ほうこく}
context: Saturday 26 December: アルちゃん and {颯太|そうた}, now on winter break, are doing {恵子|けいこ}さん's New Year shopping at the packed {商店街|しょうてんがい} supermarket, while {由紀|ゆき} demands a report on Christmas Eve over LINE.
scene: Saturday, the supermarket is packed with New Year shoppers. You're on an errand with {颯太|そうた} when {由紀|ゆき} messages: how was Christmas Eve?

phrases.jp: うわ、{美味しそう|おいしそう}！
phrases.note: The reaction to any food photo. Polite: {美味|おい}しそうですね.

phrases.jp: {雪|ゆき}が{降り|ふり}そうだね。
phrases.en: Looks like it's going to snow.
phrases.note: Verb stem + そう = it looks about to happen.
マジ = {本当|ほんとう}. With friends only.

phrases.jp: それは{大変|たいへん}でしたね。
このお{菓子|かし|sweets, snacks|4}、{子供|こども}が{喜び|よろこび}そうですね。
phrases.en: Kids would love these sweets, wouldn't they?

dialogue_setting: LINE, Saturday late morning. You're in the queue at the {商店街|しょうてんがい} supermarket; {颯太|そうた} is next to you with the basket.

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: アルちゃん〜！イブどうだった！？{報告|ほうこく}{待ってる|まってる}んだけど😤
dialogue.en: アルちゃん! How was Christmas Eve?! I'm waiting for my report 😤

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {最高|さいこう|the best|4}だった！{映画|えいが}で{二人|ふたり}とも{泣いた|ないた}ｗ
dialogue.en: It was the best! We both cried at the film lol

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: え、{次|つぎ}の{約束|やくそく}もした？
dialogue.en: Wait, did you fix the next date too?

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: うん、3{日|か}に{戸隠|とがくし}！{今|いま}は{恵子|けいこ}さんのお{使い|つかい|errand|3}でスーパー
dialogue.en: Yep, {戸隠|とがくし} on the 3rd! Right now I'm at the supermarket on an errand for {恵子|けいこ}さん.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {正月|しょうがつ|New Year|4}の{買い物|かいもの}で、レジの{列|れつ|line, queue|3}がすごい。{並んだら|ならんだら|to line up|4}30{分|ぷん}かかりそう…
dialogue.en: Everyone's doing New Year shopping, and the checkout queue is huge. Looks like 30 minutes if I join it…

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {紅白|こうはく|red and white|2}かまぼこ、{高そう|たかそう}でしょ？いつもの{倍|ばい}だよ📷
dialogue.en: Red-and-white kamaboko, looks pricey, right? Twice the usual 📷

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: うわ、{美味しそう|おいしそう}！でも{年末|ねんまつ}は{値上がり|ねあがり|price rise|3}するのよね〜
dialogue.en: Wow, looks delicious! But prices always go up at the end of the year~

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {颯太|そうた}が、お{菓子|かし|sweets, snacks|4}{売り場|うりば|sales section (of a shop)|3}に{行きたそう|いきたそう}にしてるｗ
dialogue.en: {颯太|そうた} looks like he's dying to go to the sweets aisle lol

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: ｗｗｗ {一個|いっこ}{買って|かって}あげなよ。{お兄ちゃん|おにいちゃん}でしょ！
dialogue.en: lololol buy him one. You're the big brother, aren't you!

listening.intro: {由紀|ゆき} sends a voice message as you reach the checkout.

lines.jp: {年末|ねんまつ}のスーパーって、{見てる|みてる}だけで{楽しそう|たのしそう}だよね。
lines.en: Year-end supermarkets look fun just to look at, don't they?

grammar.form: い-adj: drop い + そう ({美味|おい}しい → {美味|おい}しそう, {高|たか}い → {高|たか}そう) · な-adj: + そう ({元気|げんき}そう) · verb: stem + そう ({降|ふ}る → {降|ふ}りそう, かかる → かかりそう) · いい → よさそう · ない → なさそう
grammar.explanation: Says how something looks to you, from what you see: {美味|おい}しそう = it looks tasty. With verbs: 'about to, likely to'. Don't mix it up with plain form + そうだ ('I heard'). And かわいそう means 'poor thing', not 'looks cute'.

examples.jp: {健太|けんた}、{今日|きょう}はずっと{眠そう|ねむそう}だね。
examples.en: {健太|けんた} has looked sleepy all day.

examples.jp: {空|そら}が{暗い|くらい}。{雪|ゆき}が{降り|ふり}そうだ。
examples.en: The sky is dark. It looks like it'll snow.

quiz.question: この{伊達巻|だてまき|sweet rolled omelette|2}、すごく＿＿！
quiz.en: This rolled omelette looks so tasty!
quiz.explain: い-adjective: drop い, add そう.

quiz_more.question: レジの{列|れつ}が{長い|ながい}。30{分|ぷん}＿＿。
quiz_more.en: The checkout queue is long. Looks like it'll take 30 minutes.
quiz_more.explain: Verb stem (かかり) + そう = looks likely.

quiz_more.question: このお{店|みせ}、{安くて|やすくて}＿＿だね。
quiz_more.en: This shop looks cheap and good.
quiz_more.explain: いい is irregular: よさそう.

kanji.where: Printed on the back of the kamaboko pack in your basket.
kanji.breakdown: {要冷蔵|ようれいぞう}: {要|よう} needs + {冷蔵|れいぞう} cold storage ({冷|れい} cold + {蔵|ぞう} storehouse) → 'needs to be kept cold'.
kanji.related: {冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ} = fridge; {要予約|ようよやく} = booking required.

tip.title: Year-end shopping
tip.body: In the last days of December supermarkets fill with New Year food: {紅白|こうはく} kamaboko, {伊達巻|だてまき}, {黒豆|くろまめ}, {数の子|かずのこ}. Prices climb towards the 31st and some things sell out, so many families shop a few days early.

challenge.prompt: {恵子|けいこ}さん on the family LINE: 「スーパー{混んでる|こんでる}？」 Tell her it's really crowded and the checkout looks like it'll take about 30 minutes.
challenge.model_answer: すごく{混んで|こんで}います。レジ、30{分|ぷん}くらいかかりそうです。
challenge.explanation: {混|こ}んでいます describes the crowd right now. かかりそう is the verb stem + そう: from what you can see, it looks like it'll take 30 minutes. です keeps it polite for {恵子|けいこ}さん.
challenge.hint: verb stem + そう です

vocab.note: {最|さい} most + {高|こう} high. {最高|さいこう}だった！ = it was amazing.
お{使|つか}いに{行|い}く = run an errand (often shopping for family).
Usually お{正月|しょうがつ}: the first days of January.
{列|れつ}に{並|なら}ぶ = queue up. {行列|ぎょうれつ} = a long queue.
{並|なら}べる = put in a row (shelves, plates).
{値上|ねあ}がりする = go up in price. Opposite: {値下|ねさ}がり.
{売|う}る sell + {場|ば} place. {食品売|しょくひんう}り{場|ば} = food floor.
Covers crisps too. {和菓子|わがし} = Japanese sweets.

kanji_study.kun: なら(ぶ)・なら(べる)・なみ
kanji_study.parts: Old form 竝: two 立 (people standing) side by side → people standing in a row: line up.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 普 (ordinary): 普 is 並 with 日 sun underneath.

kanji_study.parts: 氵 water radical + 去 go away → water that flows away along a fixed course: a rule, a way of doing things.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 決 (decide): both have 氵, but 法 has 去 and 決 has 夬.

items.note: Literally 'a lie', but it's surprise, not an accusation.

extras.title: How people look
extras.intro: Describing someone from what you see.

items.jp: {元気|げんき}がなさそう。{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}？
items.en: You look down. Are you OK?
